Abdul Rahim Abdul Rehman vs The State Of Maharashtra And Anr on 10 December, 2018

Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168478788/
1 Nesarikar  2/3 04-WP-1098-16-&-Ors.odt  P.C. :
1. Respective Counsel for Petitioners point out order of Hon'ble Apex Court dated 20/09/2018 placing matter back before the High Court for considering the offences alleged under Indian Penal Code.
2. Respective Counsel have fairly stated that reference pending before Full Division Bench of this Court is in relation to proceedings under the Food and Safety Standards Act, 2006 (in short 'FSS Act' and not relevant here.
3.

They wish to demonstrate that on the basis of material collected by authorities under FSS Act,
offence under Indian Penal Code are not been substantiated.
4.
The Respondent/State has not filed reply.
Learned APP is said to be not available.
5. We direct Respondent No.1/State to file reply if any within four weeks.
In Writ Petition No.1150/15 and Writ Petition No.1165/15, charge-sheet has been filed subsequently.
In view of later development, we stay framing of charge till next date.

(SARANG V. KOTWAL, J.) (B. P. DHARMADHIKARI, J.)
